candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register subjektov nadzora (Register of Supervised Entities, SL)
candidates.why_relevant: Master statutory register with 14 entity-type filters that together define the licensed universe in SI: banks, savings banks, EEA credit institutions, branches of foreign credit institutions, special financial institutions from EEA, payment system operators (upravljavci placilnih sistemov), money changers (menjalci), payment institutions, account information service providers (AISP), discontinued payment institutions, e-money issuers, consumer credit providers/SISBON members, CSDs. Single highest-value seed list for the competitor/vendor universe every other cell samples.
candidates.legal_status: official public register published under statutory duty (ZPlaSSIED, ZBan)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic (weekly) HTML fetch of each category filter view; parse entity name + type + authorisation status into an actor table; diff against previous snapshot to detect new licences and withdrawals. Also mirror per-entity detail pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on supervisor register terminology, then direct fetch of the register page to enumerate categories

candidates.source_name: AJPES ePRS - Poslovni register Slovenije (search application)
candidates.why_relevant: Central register of every business entity in SI. Searchable by SKD activity code (e.g. 64.19 monetary intermediation, 64.99 / 66.19 other financial and auxiliary financial service activities, 62.01 software), which lets you enumerate payment/fintech/IT-vendor actors that never appear in a supervisory register. Also supports search by connected persons (founders, representatives, supervisory board) since 2018 - a strong ownership/partnership snowball.
candidates.access_status: public search free; some extracts and bulk services are paid or require registration
candidates.legal_status: official public register; commercial reuse of bulk data governed by AJPES reuse terms and price list
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the OPSI open-data extract for bulk actor lists; use ePRS UI only for targeted lookups by SKD code and by connected persons. Respect the AJPES reuse conditions for anything beyond the open dataset.

negative_findings.description: No standalone, separately published Banka Slovenije register of payment-institution AGENTS (zastopniki) and hybrid payment institutions was located as its own URL. Local-language searching indicates agents are recorded as fields inside the payment-institution and e-money-institution registers rather than as a distinct public list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched 'register zastopnikov placilnih institucij' and 'hibridne placilne institucije seznam'; results returned only the master supervised-entities register, the non-bank PSP supervision hub and the ZPlaSS/ZPlaSSIED legal texts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The agent layer is where distribution partnerships live. If agent data is only embedded per-institution, collection must parse entity detail pages rather than a single list, which changes the extraction design.

negative_findings.description: The EBA central PSD2 register search application, the ECB SSM supervised-entities list, the ESMA MiCA register and the AJPES JOLP path were not directly confirmed by a fetched page in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: These URLs are recorded from institutional design and prior knowledge rather than a confirmed search hit or fetch; the EBA search UI in particular is a JavaScript app that plain fetching may not render.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass must resolve these before they are treated as collectable. A failed fetch on them should be read as bot-defence/JS-rendering, not as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: Full bulk access to AJPES RTR and to aggregated financial data is not open data - it requires eRTR registration or a paid subscription under the AJPES price list, and natural-person accounts (type A) are legally excluded from publication.
negative_findings.result_summary: AJPES pages describe wsRtrInfoPs and bulk file subscription as reuse services with a cenik; only business-entity account data is public.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and a data-reuse agreement may be needed; personal-account data must never be collected, which constrains any account-level analysis to legal entities.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian public register was found that enumerates POS/payment-terminal vendors, acquirers' technology suppliers or payment-software integrators as such - i.e. there is no licence list for the vendor side of the market.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for activity-based enumeration only lead back to AJPES SKD codes, which are a proxy, not a vendor register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The vendor universe cannot be built from a statutory list; it must be assembled from AJPES SKD filtering plus public procurement, bank tender awards and partner pages handled by other cells.

negative_findings.description: Statutory registers contain no case-study or partnership-narrative content whatsoever.
negative_findings.result_summary: All sources in this cell yield entity identity, licence scope and status only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'case studies' topic of this run cannot be served from cell 9; it must come from vendor/bank publication cells. Cell 9's contribution is the actor list those cells sample from.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact live URL of the SI CASP (crypto-asset service provider) authorisation list maintained by ATVP under MiCA was not pinned down; only the MiCA leaflet and the register index were confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl https://www.a-tvp.si/registri/registri and the nadzorovani-subjekti section to locate and pin the CASP list URL, and cross-check against the ESMA MiCA register.

coverage_gaps.description: AML-side registers were not searched: the Urad RS za preprecevanje pranja denarja (Office for Money Laundering Prevention) and the AJPES-held Register dejanskih lastnikov (beneficial ownership register) were not covered in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run local-language queries for 'Urad RS za preprecevanje pranja denarja zavezanci' and 'register dejanskih lastnikov AJPES' to add the beneficial-ownership and AML-obliged-entity dimension to the actor graph.

coverage_gaps.description: The register of menjalci (money changers) and the register of payment system operators (upravljavci placilnih sistemov) are known to exist as filters in the BSI master register, but their dedicated sub-register URLs were not individually resolved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate each of the 14 filter views on the BSI supervised-entities register and record a stable URL/query parameter per category.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed machine-readable feed (API, CSV, XML) was identified for the Banka Slovenije registers themselves; only the AJPES/OPSI business register has a confirmed open bulk file.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check the BSI data catalogue (katalog zbirk podatkov) and podatki.gov.si for BSI-published datasets; if none exist, plan HTML parsing with diffing, or submit a ZDIJZ information-access request for the structured list.

coverage_gaps.description: Cross-border passporting lists are effectively English-only at EU level (EBA/ECB/ESMA), while the SI-side lists are Slovenian-only, and entity names are transliterated/abbreviated inconsistently between them (d.o.o., d. o. o., d.d.).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a name-normalisation and matching layer (strip legal-form suffixes, match on LEI and maticna stevilka where available) before joining SI and EU register data.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical/archived snapshots of these registers were identified, so licence entries and withdrawals that occurred before collection starts are invisible.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed the baseline from Internet Archive captures of the BSI register pages, and begin diff-based snapshotting immediately so entrant/exit events are captured going forward.

brief: Slovenia's actor universe for banking and payments is definable almost entirely from statutory registers, split across three authorities plus two EU layers: Banka Slovenije publishes the master Register subjektov nadzora with 14 licence categories (banks, savings banks, EEA credit institutions and branches, payment institutions, e-money institutions, AISPs, money changers, payment system operators, CSDs) plus dedicated sub-registers for payment institutions, e-money institutions and EEA firms passporting into Slovenia; ATVP covers investment firms, tied agents and MiCA CASPs; AJPES holds the business register (searchable by SKD activity and by connected persons), the transaction-account register RTR, annual reports and the eObjave registration feed, with a free twice-monthly open-data extract on podatki.gov.si. The EBA central PSD2 register and credit-institutions register plus the ECB SSM list are indispensable for the inbound passported firms that never appear in Slovenian media. Machine-readability is uneven: AJPES/OPSI offers clean bulk files and RTR offers a paid XML service, while the Banka Slovenije and ATVP registers appear to require HTML fetch-and-diff, and no register at all enumerates the technology-vendor side, which must be approximated via SKD codes and other cells. Several EU-level URLs here are JS applications and were not fetched in this run, so treat their liveness as unverified rather than assumed.
